description: Search the ISRCTN registry (isrctn.com) — the UK-based international clinical trial registry — by free text and/or by condition/intervention. Use for "studies on <condition> and <drug/intervention>", "trials of psilocybin for depression", or any UK/international trial not necessarily registered on ClinicalTrials.gov. At least one of query/condition/intervention is required. Combining condition and intervention narrows to trials registered under BOTH (an AND, not an OR) — a real zero means no ISRCTN trial currently pairs that condition with that intervention, and the tool says so explicitly rather than guessing. `status` filters on a DERIVED recruitment status (ISRCTN's feed carries no status field) computed from each trial's recruitment dates — see `status_basis` on every returned trial.

condition.description: Filter to trials whose registered CONDITION field matches this phrase (e.g. "stroke", "treatment-resistant depression").

intervention.description: Filter to trials whose registered INTERVENTION field matches this phrase (e.g. "psilocybin", "COMP360").

query.description: Free-text search terms (title, summary, eligibility criteria, etc.) — e.g. "psilocybin" or "psilocybin depression" (multiple words are ANDed, not ORed). Optional if condition and/or intervention are given.

status.description: Filter on the DERIVED recruitment status (case-insensitive substring match) — e.g. "recruiting", "completed", "not yet recruiting". Applied client-side over the fetched batch (see `status_filter_scanned` in the response), since ISRCTN's feed has no status field to filter on server-side.

name: isrctn_search
title: Isrctn Search
